what:
Bybit retCode 10006 ('Too many visits') on the BAR-CLOSE tick knocks out every crypto strategy for that tick. MEASURED 2026-11-06 ict-trader-live journalctl: 04:00:07Z (thread=MainThread, LINK/USDT 1h) and 04:01:03Z (BTCUSDT 1m); the #23580 cooldown then returns None from get_ohlcv, so 45 strategy builders raised 'no candle data' in 04:00-04:29Z (ml_entry x6, ml_entry_v2 x8, e4_oi_shock_1h x10, xrp_pullback_2h/ada_pullback_2h/trend_donchian_xrp_4h x2 each, ict_scalp_* , turtle_soup, fade/squeeze_breakout_4h...), smaller rounds at 02:00, 03:00, 05:01Z. Closed-bar legs recovered ~2 min late (04:02:12Z decided the 04:00 bar, no decision lost), but 5m/15m scalps and ml_entry lose the bar-close tick outright, which is the tick that matters. Cause: the all-symbol bar-close kline burst on one key; the cooldown is correct (no in-line sleep), the burst is the defect. Fix candidates (Tier 2): stagger/serialize the bar-close fetch, share one kline cache per (symbol,tf,bar) across strategies, or prefetch just after close with a budget.
